parts.refutation: timing constant k drift and window at every corner: the Nexperia 74HC423 data sheet rev. 8.1 gives k only as a typical 25 degC curve against VCC (Fig. 7; K 0.481 at 3.2 V, 0.478 at 3.3 V, 0.476 at 3.4 V, re-read here from the page rendered at 200 dpi) and no k limit or k temperature dependence at any supply. The +/-2.9 % temperature term inside the +/-3.7 % of V36 is the widening of TI CD74HC423 tW limits (40-50 us at 25 degC to 38.7-51.3 us at -40 to 85 degC) at VCC 5 V: another maker's die, another supply, and a widening of population limits, which does not bound one part's drift. The 156.5 ms to 183.5 ms corner window, 1.5 ms inside 155 ms and 185 ms, therefore rests on a term the candidate's datasheet does not state. P2 dropped MC14538BDR2G because its k drift could not be read at 3.3 V; the 74HC423's temperature term cannot be read at 3.3 V either. Every other requirement entry passes
